Mulch

Cover your soil and let nature do the work

What is it?

A layer of plant material that covers your soil.

How does it work?

  • retains moisture
  • feeds soil life
  • suppresses weeds
  • protects the structure
  • view all pros and cons

How do you apply it?

  • apply a layer of 5–10 cm
  • use what you have (grass clippings, leaves, straw)
  • top up when the layer gets too thin
  • always keep the soil covered

Nuance / when

Not once a year, but continuous topping up
